metric_definitions.drive: unique (game_id, fixed_drive) with pass/run/qb kneel/qb spike/field_goal/punt core play
metric_definitions.end_half_game: core drive whose final observed core quarter is 2 or 4 remains counted
metric_definitions.games: unique game_id in train REG PBP
metric_definitions.goal_to_go_entry: unique fixed_drive with an in-drive core or nullified pass/rush state where goal_to_go == 1
metric_definitions.kickoff_first_snap: kickoff rows are excluded; a drive is counted only upon its first core snap
metric_definitions.offensive_td: every PBP row where touchdown == 1 and td_team == posteam
metric_definitions.ot: core drive with qtr > 4; included in all drive state denominators
metric_definitions.red_zone_entry: unique fixed_drive with an in-drive core or nullified pass/rush state at yardline_100 <= 20
metric_definitions.td_per_entry: offensive TD on any PBP row in a drive that entered the named state
